title: Chevening Master's Scholarship
eligibility: Applicants from eligible Chevening countries with at least 2 years of work experience
qualification: Undergraduate degree complete at time of application
description: Chevening enables outstanding emerging leaders from around the world to pursue one-year master's degrees in the UK across any subject field.

title: Google STEP Internship
eligibility: 1st and 2nd year undergraduate students in Computer Science or related STEM fields
qualification: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in CS or related technical major
description: Student Training in Engineering Program (STEP) is a paid 12-week developmental internship for early-undergraduate students passionate about software development.

title: Software Engineer - University Graduate 2025
eligibility: Graduating within the current academic year or recent graduates within 12 months
qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
description: Full-time entry-level role building scalable cloud applications, artificial intelligence services, and enterprise software across global engineering teams.

title: Junior Frontend Engineer
eligibility: Open to global applicants with proficiency in modern web frameworks (Vue.js / React)
qualification: Bachelor's degree in CS or equivalent practical experience and portfolio projects
description: Work fully remotely with an asynchronous team, contributing to the development and user interface of GitLab's open-source DevOps platform.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to all students and self-learners globally, no prior coding experience required
description: An entry-level computer science course teaching students how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 18+ worldwide enrolled in high school, college, or university
salary: $100,000 USD Grand Prize + Azure Credits and Mentorship
qualification: Active student status at an accredited educational institution
description: Global student technology competition where student teams create innovative applications using Azure AI and cloud technologies to address pressing social issues.
